findings.title: Dry-run output filtered by emoji glyphs in user-facing text
findings.description: `DRY_RUN_KEEP = /⚠️|⊘|❌/` decides which sandbox-run lines to replay by matching the decorative glyphs inside message text. Project rules say "NEVER use user-accessible labels as logical structure." Rewording a message, or changing the `Printer` status icons, silently drops warnings from dry-run output. The glyph literals are also repeated elsewhere (`lint.ts` writes `⚠️`). `Printer` and `StdoutBuffer` should record each line's severity, for example from the `status('yellow'|'red', …)` colour. `dryRunInstall` can then replay by that field.

findings.title: A bad worktree config aborts the worktree loop, contrary to the documented behavior
findings.description: `installWorktrees` documents that a failing worktree is recorded and the loop continues, and that any other exception is a bug. `installCheckout` awaits `readRulesExclude(root)` before calling the installer. A worktree-specific problem, such as an unreadable config or an unexpected `rules.exclude` type, throws a plain `Error` from there. That aborts the remaining worktrees and skips the "failed in worktree(s)" summary. These are environment or config failures, not bugs. Catch config-read failures per worktree and count them as failed, or wrap them in a `UserError`.

findings.title: Smoke test depends on the repo's installed guide checkout
findings.description: The test reads `project-documents/ai-project-guide/project-guides` from `REPO_ROOT`. It fails, with a confusing message, in any checkout where the guide submodule is not initialized, such as a fresh clone or CI without submodule fetch. Skip it explicitly when the directory is missing (`describe.skipIf`). Alternatively, assert that the directory exists first with a clear error.

findings.title: Duplicated flag construction and a stray blank line
findings.description: `{ dryRun: opts?.dryRun ?? false, writeLint: opts?.writeLint ?? false }` is built in `setupIdeAction` and again in the command action. A small `toInstallFlags(opts)` helper would fix this. `setup-ide.test.ts` also has a double blank line before `describe('cf setup-ide')`.

findings.title: Behavior fixes are pinned by updated tests
findings.description: The #38 and #40 behavior changes (the missing final newline is kept, and the default `applyTo` is emitted once) are reflected in the unit tests and snapshots. The `rules.exclude` parsing is covered by the new `parseRulesExclude` test. Coverage for the new `lint.ts` and `dryRun.ts` is reasonable, including sandbox cleanup on abort.
